property_summary: After initializing a pool with a non-zero base token address, availableForFlashLoan returns address(this) owner check; the reference preserves the base token address, the bug sets it to address(0), causing a later flashFee calculation to return fee=0 when baseToken is address(0) and changeFee is non-zero, which is used in flashLoan to check msg.value, diverging in the success of flashLoan when the user sends no Ether.
change_summary: Replace the assignment of baseToken with address(0) to make it always zero regardless of input
